notes.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire – Dev Diary #1
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, and welcome to our very first Developer Diary! ☀️[/p][p]When we asked what you’d like to see on the [url="https://discord.gg/JWEnyVyBqX"]Discord server[/url], many of you said: [i]more info about the development.[/i] So here it is – a [b]monthly format [/b]to give you a look behind the project.[/p][p]Summer is usually a quieter time, but even with part of the team on some well-deserved rest, development kept moving forward. [b]Our main goal: getting closer to the demo you’re all waiting for.[/b][/p][p][/p][h1][b]A brand-new interface[/b][/h1][p]Until now, many UI elements were just quick placeholders. But now, an artist has designed a (nearly) complete interface, consistent with our art direction. Integration has started, and the difference is striking: everything feels clearer, smoother, and more immersive.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Reworked map and tactical support[/b][/h1][p]Two major mechanics got some serious attention this month:[/p][list][*][p][b]The map[/b]: its design and navigation have been completely reworked. It’s not finished yet, but the improvement is already huge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactical support[/b]: operations are now better organized and easier to access. Other design questions came up as well, especially around ‘usage costs’ – more on that later.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619119/3cdffb4eea45da3b4de2447569de56cd5ff8667c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619119/bcdc544ad2c7a80770a748b3f8f059abe66d3c18.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Check out this evolution! Still a work in progress (especially the wind vane and the tactical support panel), but already a huge improvement[/i][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Missions and tutorial[/b][/h1][p]We’ve also been working on the mission system: how you’ll unlock them, how they’ll chain together… At the same time, new missions are being prepared, and the tutorial is already being tested in-engine.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Art & environment[/b][/h1][p]On the art side, things are busier than ever! The team is currently overloaded because they’ve started [b]redoing the entire environment[/b]. This overhaul comes from our desire to improve mountains, roads, and landscapes. That means tons of new assets being created - rocks, vegetation, and much more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619119/05827ff5f460cfb113e0dc593454226283543f2a.png"][/img][i]A sneak peek at the new rocks, with more improvements on the way[/i][/p][p align="center"][/p][h1][b]The upgraded truck[/b][/h1][p]Your main firefighting vehicle also got some love. We added or reworked several key features: headlights, sirens, and even the horn! These changes bring more immersion and make missions feel more authentic.[/p][p]This work will lay the foundation for the next vehicles we’ll be developing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619119/6d278da0c84fac1e7cf0ba72e43cb58db5fd9ff4.gif"][/img][i]Headlights piercing through the smoke[/i][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Fire, super-sized[/b][/h1][p]This is without a doubt one of the biggest technical breakthroughs of recent weeks: we’ve gone from handling [b]6,000 to 500,000 burnable elements[/b]. A huge leap forward that makes wildfires feel far more realistic.[/p][p]Our fire propagation algorithm, which we’ve been developing for nearly two years, is a unique system we’re especially proud of – something no other simulator has achieved so far. We’ll share more about it in a dedicated video that dives into all the details.[/p][p]Of course, such progress also requires plenty of fine-tuning for existing mechanics… so trust us, the developers are anything but bored![/p][p][/p][h1][b]And also…[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Progress on integrating the game into Steam and the Epic Games Store.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvements to details, such as backpacks (straps now follow the shoulders more naturally).[/p][/*][*][p]A new display system for carbon monoxide poisoning.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s it for our very first Dev Diary! We hope you enjoy this new format and that it gives you a clearer picture of our progress. Let us know what you think![/p][p]Thank you again for your support, and see you next month for the next update![/p][p][/p][p]❤️ Rescue Ops: Wildfire Team[/p]

notes.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire - Gameplay Sneak Preview
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone! [/b][/p][p][/p][p]It’s been 2 months since our last update. And now we’re targeting 50,000 wishlists [i](we’re almost there!)[/i] and [b]we’re revealing our first gameplay video[/b]. AHHH we’re so excited [i](and a little nervous [/i]😅[i])[/i].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="wZwqYNk50KQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In this early look, you’ll discover: 👇[/p][list][*][p]The core firefighting mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Hose and water supply management[/p][/*][*][p]Fire extinguishing and a sneak peek of different spray types[/p][/*][*][p]Our vehicle system and some tools[/p][/*][*][p]A glimpse at future features in development[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We’re looking forward to your feedback whether on Steam, Discord, or social media that you can find on our [url="https://linktr.ee/rescueops_game"][u]Linktree[/u][/url]. Thank you for being part of this adventure![/p][p][/p][p]❤️ The Rescue Ops Team[/p]

notes.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire - Reveal Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

It’s hard to believe it’s only been a week since we announced [b]Rescue Ops: Wildfire[/b], and we've already passed [b]25,000 wishlists[/b]!

This first week has been incredible — we’re still processing all the love, excitement, and support you’ve shown us. Reading your messages, seeing your posts on social media, and discovering press articles about the game has meant the world to us.

[b]THANK YOU so much![/b]✨

[previewyoutube=KZEHa6LAMCU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🧑‍🚒 Grab your gear and answer the call[/h3]
[b]Rescue Ops: Wildfire[/b] is an immersive and dynamic firefighter simulation game where you’ll face unpredictable, large-scale wildfires — solo or in co-op. Use a variety of ground and aerial vehicles, fire hose systems, tactical support tools, and more to battle the blaze.

We’re aiming for an [b]Early Access[/b] launch in [b]late 2025 or early 2026[/b], so we can gather your feedback and build the best experience possible with you.

🔥 Want to learn more, chat with the dev team, and hang out with some amazing people? [b]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/JWEnyVyBqX]Discord[/url]![/b]  

Have a great week — and once again:
[b]THANK YOU[/b]❤️

notes.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire could be a good one for co-op fans where you fight raging infernos
notes.notes:
Rescue Ops: Wildfire is an upcoming immersive firefighter simulation game where you (and friends, if you have any) get to attempt to put out dynamic, unpredictable mega-fires.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/rescue-ops-wildfire-could-be-a-good-one-for-co-op-fans-where-you-fight-raging-infernos/
